{{Youmay|the device|the [[Heat-seal|medical procedure]]}}
A '''heat-sealer''' was device used by the [[Malkite Poisoners]], and found within their [[Malkite poisoner's kit|poisoner's kit]]. The heat-sealer could close puncture wounds made by the kit's needles, when in direct contact with the wound. This allowed the poisoner to disguise the method of a target's death by leaving no trace of the entry wound.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
